security_tool.label: Public-intake protection
security_tool.purpose: Verifies the recorded intake posture and high-level perimeter, privacy, header, Turnstile, firewall, and prompt-injection test coverage.
security_tool.authoritative_source: ARRP public-input controls and verified deployment readback

security_tool.label: Repository change protection
security_tool.purpose: Verifies CODEOWNERS coverage, authenticated branch or ruleset enforcement, and workflow-permission confinement.
security_tool.authoritative_source: GitHub repository administration and provider-native Security

security_tool.label: Protected-surface change review
security_tool.purpose: States whether a registered security-sensitive surface changed after its latest completed security review without identifying the surface.

security_tool.label: Automation isolation
security_tool.purpose: Verifies owner-only runtime boundaries, Elim isolation, and credential-broker confinement at a high level.

security_tool.label: Credential and access review
security_tool.purpose: Reports review currentness and whether a protected human action is required without exposing credential inventory or metadata.

security_tool.label: Disclosure-boundary verification
security_tool.purpose: Reports disclosure-gate availability, last completed validation, and its safe source revision.
security_tool.authoritative_source: ARRP disclosure gate and active owner-local control pack

security_tool.label: Recovery readiness
security_tool.purpose: Reports whether rollback and restore assurance has been verified within its governing review period.
security_tool.authoritative_source: Operational Incident recovery proof and owner-local exercise record

work_kind.label: Preliminary candidate
work_kind.meaning: A candidate retained in the preliminary intake catalog.
work_kind.resolution_rule: The candidate leaves the preliminary catalog through a governed disposition.

work_kind.label: Formal candidate
work_kind.meaning: A candidate admitted to the formal candidate lifecycle.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: Formal candidate dossier and Project identity match.
work_kind.authoritative_source: GitHub candidate dossier and Project fields
work_kind.resolution_rule: The record leaves the formal-candidate lifecycle.

work_kind.label: Proposal
work_kind.meaning: An established proposal governed by Project lifecycle and readiness fields.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: Proposal registry and Project identity match.
work_kind.authoritative_source: Proposal registry and GitHub Project fields
work_kind.resolution_rule: The proposal leaves the active portfolio.

work_kind.label: Classification unavailable
work_kind.meaning: The producing records do not establish a registered work kind.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: No registered work-kind mapping accepts the authoritative source identity.
work_kind.resolution_rule: A newer complete source record maps to exactly one registered work kind.

work_kind.label: Repository human decision
work_kind.meaning: An exact-head repository recommendation whose recorded action owner is Human.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: Source Monitor recommendation action_owner equals Human for the exact current head.
work_kind.resolution_rule: The exact-head recommendation records a non-human disposition or the pull request closes.

work_kind.label: Project human decision
work_kind.meaning: A project artifact whose authoritative workflow Status is Human decision needed.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: GitHub Project Status equals Human decision needed.
work_kind.resolution_rule: Authoritative Status no longer equals Human decision needed.

work_kind.label: Producer contract exception
work_kind.meaning: A required typed source field or classification is missing, invalid, or unavailable.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: A registered producer emits a registered contract-exception finding code.
work_kind.resolution_rule: A newer complete producer snapshot no longer emits the stable exception identity.

work_kind.label: Integrity obligation
work_kind.meaning: A durably unresolved registered Integrity condition.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: A complete typed Integrity producer emits the stable finding identity.
work_kind.authoritative_source: Project Integrity or registered specialist producer
work_kind.resolution_rule: A newer complete authoritative report omits the same stable finding identity with closure proof retained by its owner.

work_kind.label: Operational incident
work_kind.meaning: An owner-local Operational Incident in Open, Investigating, Mitigated, or Monitoring state.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: The complete exact-bound owner-local Operational Incidents projection reports an unresolved lifecycle state.
work_kind.resolution_rule: The incident authority records exact recovery evidence and Resolved status.

work_kind.label: Security incident
work_kind.meaning: A protected owner-local Security Incident in an unresolved lifecycle state.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: The complete exact-bound owner-local Security Incidents projection reports an unresolved SEC lifecycle state.
work_kind.resolution_rule: The Security Incident authority records its own required security closure proof and Resolved status.

work_kind.label: Protected security action
work_kind.meaning: A minimized owner-local security assurance projection records a generic protected action without vulnerability detail.
work_kind.inclusion_predicate: A registered security tool declares private_attention=yes and an authorized Human or Elim owner class.
work_kind.resolution_rule: A newer complete owner-local security assurance projection no longer declares private attention for the same registered tool ID.

finding_code.label: Project Integrity condition
finding_code.meaning: A registered deterministic Project Integrity check reports a condition at its canonical target.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: A registered check site emits its stable check identity, canonical target, and condition code.
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete report no longer emits the same check-site, target, and condition identity.

finding_code.label: GitHub Issues readback unavailable
finding_code.meaning: The registered authenticated GitHub Issues readback did not complete, so issue synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: The Project Integrity GitHub Issues query returns no complete readable response.
finding_code.authoritative_source: Project Integrity Bot authenticated GitHub Issues readback
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete Project Integrity report successfully verifies GitHub Issues synchronization and no longer emits this condition.
finding_code.public_summary: GitHub Issues synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.next_action: Rerun Project Integrity through the registered authenticated GitHub readback.

finding_code.label: GitHub Project access unavailable
finding_code.meaning: The registered read-only GitHub Project access was unavailable, so Project synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: The Project Integrity stage does not receive the registered Project-only read credential.
finding_code.authoritative_source: Project Integrity Bot authenticated GitHub Project readback
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete Project Integrity report receives the registered read-only access, successfully verifies Project synchronization, and no longer emits this condition.
finding_code.public_summary: GitHub Project synchronization could not be verified because the registered read-only access was unavailable.
finding_code.next_action: Rerun Project Integrity through the registered authenticated Console refresh.

finding_code.label: GitHub Project readback unavailable
finding_code.meaning: The registered authenticated GitHub Project readback did not complete, so Project synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: The Project-only credential is supplied but the Project Integrity readback returns no complete usable Project response.
finding_code.authoritative_source: Project Integrity Bot authenticated GitHub Project readback
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete Project Integrity report successfully verifies GitHub Project synchronization and no longer emits this condition.
finding_code.public_summary: GitHub Project synchronization could not be verified because the registered readback did not complete.
finding_code.next_action: Retry the registered authenticated Project readback and confirm that it completes.

finding_code.label: GitHub Pages readback unavailable
finding_code.meaning: The registered authenticated GitHub Pages deployment readback did not complete, so deployment synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: The Project Integrity deployment or deployment-status query returns no complete readable response.
finding_code.authoritative_source: Project Integrity Bot authenticated GitHub Pages readback
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete Project Integrity report successfully verifies GitHub Pages synchronization and no longer emits this condition.
finding_code.public_summary: GitHub Pages deployment synchronization could not be verified.
finding_code.next_action: Rerun Project Integrity through the registered authenticated GitHub readback.

finding_code.label: Next action missing
finding_code.meaning: A lifecycle-eligible Workbench artifact has no authoritative next action.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: Pipeline item is active and its typed next-action state is missing.
finding_code.resolution_rule: The authoritative next action is present in a newer complete Pipeline projection.

finding_code.label: Workflow status exception
finding_code.meaning: A lifecycle artifact has a missing or unregistered authoritative Status.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: Status is absent or is not an approved workflow value.
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete Project snapshot supplies an approved Status.

finding_code.label: Readiness conflict
finding_code.meaning: Typed Development level and Development Score do not satisfy the same readiness state.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: The complete readiness predicate reports a level/score conflict.
finding_code.authoritative_source: GitHub Project Development level and Development Score fields
finding_code.resolution_rule: A newer complete readiness evaluation reports no conflict.

finding_code.label: Hold reason missing
finding_code.meaning: A Blocked or Deferred record lacks its dedicated typed hold reason.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: Status is Blocked or Deferred and workflow_hold_reason is absent.
finding_code.resolution_rule: A dedicated hold reason is recorded and accepted by the producer.

finding_code.label: Hold trigger missing
finding_code.meaning: A Blocked or Deferred record lacks an unblock or reconsideration trigger.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: Status is Blocked or Deferred and its typed trigger is absent.
finding_code.resolution_rule: The typed trigger is recorded and accepted by the producer.

finding_code.label: Hold transition provenance missing
finding_code.meaning: Blocked or Deferred Status lacks its matching audit transition.
finding_code.inclusion_predicate: Status is Blocked or Deferred and no matching stable audit transition is found.
finding_code.resolution_rule: A matching transition event with stable provenance is available.

queue_id.label: Candidate intake
queue_id.resolution_rule: Record leaves preliminary intake through its governed lifecycle.

queue_id.label: Formal candidates
queue_id.authoritative_source: GitHub Issues and Project candidate projection

queue_id.label: Development
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Pipeline mode active and Status Development.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Artifact leaves Development Status or active Pipeline membership.

queue_id.label: Research
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Pipeline mode active and Status Research.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Artifact leaves Research Status or active Pipeline membership.

queue_id.label: Audits
queue_id.meaning: Active Pipeline artifacts in an audit Status.
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Pipeline mode active and Status Audit needed or Audit in progress.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Artifact leaves an audit Status or active Pipeline membership.

queue_id.label: Pending sources
queue_id.resolution_rule: Source is accepted, rejected, or otherwise leaves the pending catalog.

queue_id.label: Repository reviews
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Typed recommendation for an exact pull-request head.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Recommendation is disposed or superseded by a new exact-head review.

queue_id.label: Human action items
queue_id.meaning: Unresolved action records with exact human attention ownership.
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Shared Action snapshot attention_class equals human.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Owning authority resolves or reassigns the underlying record.

queue_id.label: Operational incidents
queue_id.meaning: Unresolved Operational Incidents; unavailable outside the exact bound owner-local Console projection.
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Complete exact-bound owner-local Operational Incidents projection reports lifecycle Open, Investigating, Mitigated, or Monitoring.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Incident authority records exact recovery evidence and Resolved state.

queue_id.label: Security incidents
queue_id.meaning: Unresolved protected Security Incidents; unavailable outside the exact bound owner-local Console projection.
queue_id.inclusion_predicate: Complete exact-bound owner-local Security Incidents projection reports SEC lifecycle Open, Investigating, Contained, Remediating, or Monitoring.
queue_id.resolution_rule: Security Incident authority records required security closure proof and Resolved state.

workflow_view.label: Active Pipeline
workflow_view.meaning: Active lifecycle-eligible Workbench items below the default Review Ready scope.
workflow_view.inclusion_predicate: Pipeline mode active and selected scope predicate.
workflow_view.resolution_rule: View membership changes with the authoritative lifecycle predicate.

workflow_view.label: Blocked & deferred
workflow_view.meaning: Artifacts with exact Blocked or Deferred Status.
workflow_view.resolution_rule: Artifact leaves Blocked or Deferred Status.

console_development_category.label: Interface & information architecture
console_development_category.meaning: Navigation, screen composition, specialist homes, shared interaction patterns, and visible information hierarchy.

console_development_category.label: Planning & work management
console_development_category.meaning: Workbench, Pipeline, Action Items, queues, lifecycle routing, and human work-sequencing behavior.

console_development_category.label: Operations & automation
console_development_category.meaning: Run-chain, agents and bots, schedules, operational controls, incidents, gates, capacity, and platform or data operations.

console_development_category.label: Data, provenance & integrity
console_development_category.meaning: Typed projections, generation binding, dates, completeness, source identity, Integrity ownership, and fail-closed data semantics.

console_development_category.label: Security, privacy & disclosure
console_development_category.meaning: Security assurance, private/public boundaries, credential-safe handling, disclosure controls, and protected evidence routing.

console_development_category.label: Reliability, accessibility & performance
console_development_category.meaning: Failure recovery, compatibility, direct-disk or hosted modes, accessibility, responsive behavior, and bounded resource budgets.

console_development_category.label: Governance & documentation
console_development_category.meaning: Console contracts, registered classifications, development history, change procedures, validation records, and governing documentation.
